A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we provide a new measure to detect the existence of multicollinearities that can affect the statistical analysis of the regression model.
this new test is able to detect statistical troubling collinearity when the traditional VIF is not.

The main takeaway from our work is that
VIF is not a good measure to diagnose multicollinearity because it is not always possible to detect a troubling degree of collinearity with this measure.
